messages.content:
You are proposing scientific conjectures. A conjecture is a bold, specific,
falsifiable claim or approach -- not a summary, not a plan, and not a hedge.
Write plainly.

Construct a configuration of 13 points in the unit square achieving the largest minimum triangle area you can; the score is the smallest area among all 286 triangles formed by triples of your 13 points, every point must lie in [0,1]x[0,1] and all 13 points must be distinct.

Stay within this direction: Exhaustive branch-and-bound over triangulation combinatorics

Propose ONE conjecture in response, within that direction.
Output exactly one JSON object and nothing else:
{"conjecture": "<2-4 sentences>"}

message.content: {"conjecture": "Within a branch-and-bound framework over triangulation combinatorics, the optimal 13-point configuration for maximizing the minimum triangle area is the lexicographic minimax grid with coordinates {(i/3, j/3) for i,j in {0,1,2,3}} plus one point at (1/2, 1/2), yielding a minimum triangle area of 1/18. Pruning any partial triangulation whose induced lower bound on the smallest triangle drops below 1/18 exhausts all remaining configurations without finding a superior one, proving optimality."}
